description: This file is a shell library designed for testing Git credential helpers. It provides functions to check credential storage, retrieval, rejection, and clean-up processes, including handling of various credential scenarios such as long headers, password expiry, OAuth tokens, authtype management, and timeout conditions.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Reads credential command parameters, executes the Git credential command, and compares its output against expected values to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin until a separator '--' is encountered, outputting the lines for processing.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Resets credential helper's residual data by rejecting various credentials to start with a clean state.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects specific credentials for given protocol, host, and username combinations via git credential reject command.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive set of tests on a specified credential helper to verify storing, retrieving, overwriting, forgetting, and handling various credential scenarios.

methods.name: helper_test_timeout
methods.description: Tests credential helper timeout handling by inducing delays and verifying behavior after timeout.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Verifies the storage and retrieval of password expiry timestamps within credentials.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens in credentials.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests handling of authtype and credential storage, including matching capabilities and optional fields.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Outputs a simple shell script that acts as a mock GIT_ASKPASS helper, designed for testing credential prompts.
